title: Tallow & Brook month-end close runbook
brief: Tallow & Brook Distribution's finance operations team needs a month-end close runbook that the accounting staff can follow, owned by the Controller, version dated 2026-10-01, with a goal of closing the books within 5 working days. Section "Calendar": working day 1, cut off sales and purchasing at 17:00 and finish bank reconciliations; day 2, post accruals and depreciation and reconcile inventory to the warehouse count; day 3, eliminate intercompany balances between the three legal entities and reconcile payroll; day 4, review variances; day 5, the Controller signs off and the books lock at 12:00. Section "Before sign-off", a short checklist: every balance sheet account is reconciled; any reconciling difference is under 50 dollars or explained; variances over 5 percent and over 10000 dollars each have a written explanation; intercompany balances net to zero; the trial balance debits equal credits. Section "If a deadline slips", steps in order: 1 tell the Controller the same day; 2 decide whether the slip delays sign-off, and if day 5 will be missed by more than 1 working day, notify the CFO, Valentina Sokolov; 3 do not post late entries after the lock without a reopen request signed by the Controller; 4 record the cause in the close log. Make sure everyone sees that the books lock at 12:00 on day 5 and nothing is posted after that without an approved reopen request. Finish with "Contacts": Controller, Marcus Eldridge; Accounts payable lead, Noor Haddad; CFO, Valentina Sokolov.

edit.request: Change the lock time to 15:00 and the variance thresholds to 3 percent and 5000 dollars, and add an item to the Before sign-off checklist: "Bank balances agree to statements".
